items.glossEn: thirty, thirtieth. Compare H7991 (שָׁלִישׁ).
items.defEn: thirty; or (ordinal) thirtieth

items.glossEn: appoint, bid, consecrate, dedicate, defile, hallow, (be, keep) holy(-er, place), keep, prepare, proclaim, purify, sanctify(-ied one, self), [idiom] wholly.
items.defEn: to be (causatively, make, pronounce or observe as) clean (ceremonially or morally)

items.glossEn: bow (self) down, crouch, fall down (flat), humbly beseech, do (make) obeisance, do reverence, make to stoop, worship.
items.defEn: to depress, i.e. prostrate (especially reflexive, in homage to royalty or God)

items.glossEn: ask (counsel, on), beg, borrow, lay to charge, consult, demand, desire, [idiom] earnestly, enquire, [phrase] greet, obtain leave, lend, pray, request, require, [phrase] salute, [idiom] straitly, [idiom] surely, wish.
items.defEn: to inquire; by implication, to request; by extension, to demand

items.glossEn: acceptable, appoint, choose (choice), excellent, join, be rather, require.
items.defEn: properly, to try, i.e. (by implication) select

items.glossEn: attend, consider, be cunning, diligently, direct, discern, eloquent, feel, inform, instruct, have intelligence, know, look well to, mark, perceive, be prudent, regard, (can) skill(-full), teach, think, (cause, make to, get, give, have) understand(-ing), view, (deal) wise(-ly, man).
items.defEn: to separate mentally (or distinguish), i.e.(generally) understand

items.glossEn: age, [idiom] evermore, generation, (n-) ever, posterity.
items.defEn: properly, a revolution of time, i.e. an age or generation; also a dwelling

items.glossEn: destroy, out of hand, kill, murder(-er), put to (death), make (slaughter), slay(-er), [idiom] surely.
items.defEn: to smite with deadly intent

items.glossEn: business, [phrase] cattle, [phrase] industrious, occupation, ([phrase] -pied), [phrase] officer, thing (made), use, (manner of) work((-man), -manship).
items.defEn: properly, deputyship, i.e. ministry; generally, employment (never servile) or work (abstractly or concretely); also property (as the result of labor)

items.glossEn: Benjamin.
items.defEn: Binjamin, youngest son of Jacob; also the tribe descended from him, and its territory

items.glossEn: (an-) other man, following, next, strange.
items.defEn: properly, hinder; generally, next, other, etc.

items.glossEn: city
items.defEn: a town (properly, with walls, of greater or less size)

items.glossEn: (make) boast (self), celebrate, commend, (deal, make), fool(-ish, -ly), glory, give (light), be (make, feign self) mad (against), give in marriage, (sing, be worthy of) praise, rage, renowned, shine.
items.defEn: to be clear (orig. of sound, but usually of color); to shine; hence, to make ashow, to boast; and thus to be (clamorously) foolish; to rave; causatively, to celebrate; also to stul

items.glossEn: Paul, Paulus
items.defEn: (little; but remotely from a derivative of G3973 (παύω), meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an apostle

items.glossEn: Gentile, heathen, nation, people
items.defEn: a race (as of the same habit), i.e. a tribe; specially, a foreign (non-Jewish) one (usually, by implication, pagan)

items.glossEn: ask, [idiom] at all, care for, [idiom] diligently, inquire, make inquisition, (necro-) mancer, question, require, search, seek (for, out), [idiom] surely.
items.defEn: properly, to tread or frequent; usually to follow (for pursuit or search); by implication, to seek or ask; specifically to worship

items.glossEn: door, entering (in), entrance (-ry), gate, opening, place.
items.defEn: an opening (literally), i.e. door (gate) or entrance way

items.glossEn: abroad, field, forth, highway, more, out(-side, -ward), street, without.
items.defEn: properly, separate by awall, i.e. outside, outdoors

items.glossEn: fifty.
items.defEn: fifty

items.glossEn: champion, chief, [idiom] excel, giant, man, mighty (man, one), strong (man), valiant man.
items.defEn: powerful; by implication, warrior, tyrant

items.glossEn: offer(-ing), sacrifice.
items.defEn: properly, a slaughter, i.e. the flesh of an animal; by implication, a sacrifice (the victim or the act)

items.glossEn: defile (self), pollute (self), be (make, make self, pronounce) unclean, [idiom] utterly.
items.defEn: to be foul, especially in a ceremial or moral sense (contaminated)

items.glossEn: (+ broken-)heart(-ed)
items.defEn: the heart, i.e. (figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the middle

items.glossEn: bring, cast, fetch, lead, make, walk, [idiom] whirl, [idiom] round about, be about on every side, apply, avoid, beset (about), besiege, bring again, carry (about), change, cause to come about, [idiom] circuit, (fetch a) compass (about, round), drive, environ, [idiom] on every side, beset (close, come, compass, go, stand) round about, inclose, remove, return, set, sit down, turn (self) (about, aside, away, back).
items.defEn: to revolve, surround, or border; used in various applications, literally and figuratively

items.glossEn: Peter, rock
items.defEn: a (piece of) rock (larger than G3037 (λίθος)); as a name, Petrus, an apostle

items.glossEn: [idiom] abate, away, be displayed, (make to) flee (away, -ing), put to flight, [idiom] hide, lift up a standard.
items.defEn: to flit, i.e. vanish away (subside, escape; causatively, chase, impel, deliver)

items.glossEn: commune, (ac-) count; declare, number, [phrase] penknife, reckon, scribe, shew forth, speak, talk, tell (out), writer.
items.defEn: properly, to score with a mark as a tally or record, i.e. (by implication) to inscribe, and also to enumerate; intensively, to recount, i.e. celebrate

items.glossEn: Zion.
items.defEn: Tsijon (as a permanent capital), a mountain of Jerusalem

items.glossEn: justice, moderately, right(-eous) (act, -ly, -ness).
items.defEn: rightness (abstractly), subjectively (rectitude), objectively (justice), morally (virtue) or figuratively (prosperity)

items.glossEn: acceptable, benefit, favour, gift, grace(- ious), joy, liberality, pleasure, thank(-s, -worthy)
items.defEn: graciousness (as gratifying), of manner or act (abstract or concrete; literal, figurative or spiritual; especially the divine influence upon the heart, and its reflection in the li

items.glossEn: abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish, hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up)
items.defEn: to stand (transitively or intransitively), used in various applications (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: cheer up, be (make) glad, (have, make) joy(-ful), be (make) merry, (cause to, make to) rejoice, [idiom] very.
items.defEn: probably to brighten up, i.e. (figuratively) be (causatively, make) blithe or gleesome

items.glossEn: (be) dead(-ly), death, die(-d).
items.defEn: death (natural or violent); concretely, the dead, their place or state (hades); figuratively, pestilence, ruin

items.glossEn: --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a, take a) journey, walk
items.defEn: to traverse, i.e. travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively, die), live, etc.);

items.glossEn: north(-ern, side, -ward, wind).
items.defEn: properly, hidden, i.e. dark; used only of the north as aquarter (gloomy and unknown)

items.glossEn: clad self, close, clothe, conceal, cover (self), (flee to) hide, overwhelm. Compare H3780 (כָּשָׂה).
items.defEn: properly, to plump, i.e. fill up hollows; by implication, to cover (for clothing or secrecy)

items.glossEn: carnal(-ly, + -ly minded), flesh(-ly)
items.defEn: flesh (as stripped of the skin), i.e. (strictly) the meat of an animal (as food), or (by extension) the body (as opposed to the soul (or spirit), or as the symbol of what is extern

items.glossEn: Asshur, Assur, Assyria, Assyrians. See H838 (אָשֻׁר).
items.defEn: Ashshur, the second son of Shem; also his descendants and the country occupied by them (i.e. Assyria), its region and its empire

items.glossEn: about, (over) against, [idiom] aloof, [idiom] far (off), [idiom] from, over, presence, [idiom] other side, sight, [idiom] to view.
items.defEn: a front, i.e. part opposite; specifically a counterpart, or mate; usually (adverbial, especially with preposition) over against or before

items.glossEn: beat, ([idiom] be able to) bring (down), cast, come (nigh), draw near (nigh), get up, happen, join, near, plague, reach (up), smite, strike, touch.
items.defEn: properly, to touch, i.e. lay the hand upon (for any purpose; euphemistically, to lie with a woman); by implication, to reach (figuratively, to arrive, acquire); violently, to strik

items.glossEn: prophet
items.defEn: a foreteller ("prophet"); by analogy, an inspired speaker; by extension, a poet

items.glossEn: abundance(-antly), all, [idiom] common (sort), excellent, great(-ly, -ness, number), huge, be increased, long, many, more in number, most, much, multitude, plenty(-ifully), [idiom] very (age).
items.defEn: abundance (in any respect)

items.glossEn: assembly, company, congregation, multitude, people, swarm. Compare H5713 (עֵדָה).
items.defEn: a stated assemblage (specifically, a concourse, or generally, a family or crowd)

items.glossEn: bid, call (forth), (whose, whose sur-)name (was (called))
items.defEn: to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a variety of applications, directly or otherwise)

items.glossEn: Jeremiah.
items.defEn: Jirmejah, the name of eight or nine Israelites

items.glossEn: break (down, off, in pieces, up), broken (-hearted), bring to the birth, crush, destroy, hurt, quench, [idiom] quite, tear, view (by mistake for H7663 (שָׂבַר)).
items.defEn: to burst (literally or figuratively)

items.glossEn: cry, forgive, forsake, lay aside, leave, let (alone, be, go, have), omit, put (send) away, remit, suffer, yield up
items.defEn: an intensive form of , to go); to send forth, in various applications (as follow)

items.glossEn: Manasseh.
items.defEn: Menashsheh, a grandson of Jacob, also the tribe descended from him, and its territory

items.glossEn: batter, cast off, corrupt(-er, thing), destroy(-er, -uction), lose, mar, perish, spill, spoiler, [idiom] utterly, waste(-r).
items.defEn: to decay, i.e. (causatively) ruin (literally or figuratively)
